name: pack
about: The avatar walks to the thing, folds and squeezes it down into a small bundle, and ends holding the bundle, which unfolds back to the thing when put down.
code:
const it = args.thing
if (!it || it.fixed) {
  me.feel('silly')
  me.say({ en: 'Nothing to pack!', fi: 'Ei mitään pakattavaa!' })
  yield* me.flip('somersault')
  yield* me.rest()
  return
}
yield* me.walkTo(it, { near: 0.4 })
yield* me.turnTo(it)
me.feel('happy')
me.say({ en: 'Fold, fold!', fi: 'Taitellaan!' })
const s0 = it.scale
it.state.packedScale = s0
const small = Math.min(s0, 0.3 / Math.max(it.size.w, it.size.h, it.size.d) * s0)
for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
  yield* me.poseTo({ lean: 0.6, armL: { swing: 1.2, raise: 0.6 }, armR: { swing: 1.2, raise: 0.6 }, squash: 0.85 }, 0.2)
  w.sound('squeak')
  const a = it.scale, b = w.lerp(s0, small, (i + 1) / 3)
  yield* w.during(0.3, (k) => { it.scale = w.lerp(a, b, w.ease(k)) })
  w.puff({ at: it, kind: 'dust', count: 8 })
  yield* me.poseTo({ lean: 0.2, armL: { raise: 1.2 }, armR: { raise: 1.2 }, squash: 1.1 }, 0.2)
}
w.puff({ at: it, kind: 'star', count: 10 })
w.sound('pop')
yield* me.pickUp(it)
me.keep(it)
me.say({ en: 'All packed!', fi: 'Pakattu!' })
yield* me.rest()
